name: remnus
description: Read and write your Remnus workspace, pages, databases, kanban boards, directly from Claude.
long_description: Remnus is the MCP-native Human-Agent Collaborative Workspace. This extension connects Claude Desktop to your Remnus workspace over a secure remote MCP server. Sign in once with OAuth (no token to paste) and Claude can search, read, create, and update your pages and database rows. Self-hosters can point the extension at their own instance via the configuration field.

server_url.title: Remnus MCP URL
server_url.description: The Remnus MCP endpoint. Leave as-is unless you self-host Remnus.

tools.name: prepare_context
tools.description: Build one task-specific, token-budgeted context pack from relevant workspace pages. Ranks lexical matches, prefers human-reviewed OKF knowledge, penalizes stale/deprecated concepts, and adds the top result's link-graph neighbors. Use this before multi-page product or coding work instead of many search/get_page calls.

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.description: Search the workspace by title and content. Matches standalone pages, databases, and database rows (each row is a page) on their title or body text. Use it to locate an item before reading or updating it.

tools.name: list_workspace
tools.description: List workspace items (pages and databases). Optionally filter by parent. Supports cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get content of a workspace page or database row by its ID. Auto-detects the type, no flags needed. Supports an outline mode for a token-cheap skim before fetching the full content.

tools.name: get_pages
tools.description: Get multiple workspace pages or database rows by ID in one call, for a specific, already-known, possibly mixed list of IDs. One missing/inaccessible ID does not fail the batch.

tools.name: get_database_schema
tools.description: Get the column schema and saved views of a database, without fetching any rows.

tools.name: query_audit_log
tools.description: Query the MCP agent activity audit log for this workspace. Supports filtering by tool name, status, and date range.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List all members of the workspace with their roles and join dates.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Get schema and rows of a database. Row markdown bodies are not included by default. Optionally filter rows by property values and project with fields to fetch only needed columns.

tools.name: get_changes_since
tools.description: Get a compact list of everything that changed in the workspace since a given time or a previous call's cursor, pages/databases edited, rows edited, and items deleted. Built for recurring agents to sync incrementally.

tools.name: get_related_pages
tools.description: Get a page's knowledge-graph neighborhood in one compact call: parent, child pages, outgoing links, backlinks, and sibling rows for database rows.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new standalone page (nested via parentId) or a database row (via databaseId).

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update a page or database row. Only the fields you pass are changed; row properties are merged, not replaced.

tools.name: bulk_update_pages
tools.description: Update multiple pages or database rows in one call, same merge semantics as update_page per entry.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a workspace page, database, or database row. Requires confirm: true to execute.

tools.name: move_item
tools.description: Move a sidebar item (page or database) to a new parent within the workspace.

tools.name: create_database
tools.description: Create a new database with a custom schema.

tools.name: update_database_schema
tools.description: Add or remove columns from a database schema. Removing columns is destructive and requires confirm: true.

tools.name: create_database_view
tools.description: Add a new saved view (table, kanban, or calendar) to a database.

tools.name: update_database_view
tools.description: Rename a database view, change its icon, or patch fields within its existing config.

tools.name: delete_database_view
tools.description: Delete a saved view from a database. Requires confirm: true. A database must always keep at least one view.
